purpose: Planned host-neutral activation and boundary scenarios for skill-change-gate; presence is not execution evidence.

contract_catalog.SCG-001: Gate proposed changes to an existing skill for regression-safe acceptance.
contract_catalog.SCG-002: Do not take ownership of creation, benchmarking, broad repair, ordinary application review, or documentation rewriting.
contract_catalog.SCG-003: Treat generic skill-update review as conditional on candidate evidence and requested gate intent.
contract_catalog.SCG-004: Preserve evidence identity, validation truthfulness, receipt correspondence, and independent gate authority.
contract_catalog.SCG-005: Keep gate outputs outside the candidate/baseline mutation surface.
contract_catalog.SCG-006: Treat evaluator visibility or leakage as independent acceptance evidence, not as a hash-only concern.
contract_catalog.SCG-007: Require known consumer compatibility before an ecosystem-safe contract-change acceptance claim.
